description.de:
Blondina lebt als Waise ein Leben in Armut, bis sich herausstellt, dass sie eine Prinzessin des Kaiserrreichs Ates ist. Auch innerhalb des Palastes ist Blondina eine Außenseiterin und versucht, bloß nicht aufzufallen. Ihr trister Alltag ändert sich schlagartig, als sie sich mit Aimon anfreundet, einem heiligen Panther, der wie ein süßes kleines Kätzchen aussieht. Können Blondina und Aimon es schaffen, die Feindseligkeiten, die zwischen den Menschen und den heiligen Tieren schon jahrhundertelang bestehen, beizulegen?

description.en:
Blondina is living a real-life Cinderella story. After growing up poor and enduring a difficult childhood, she discovers that she is a princess of the Ates empire. However, her estranged father and half-siblings give her the cold shoulder when she moves into the palace, and Blondina must keep a low profile. That all changes when she befriends Amon, a cat-like creature with mysterious intentions. For years, creatures like Amon and humans have struggled to live in harmony. Can Blondina and Amon’s friendship bring peace, or will it deepen the rift between their people?

---
Blondina, a princess who had commoner’s blood, lived quietly in a separate palace. Due to her mixed blood, she received ill-treatment and was surrounded with contempt. One day, she happened upon a wounded black cat and decided to treat it. But, the lovely cat she assumed it to be was actually…?

“If you run away like that, of course, I’d want to hunt you.”

Amon’s lips gently wandered down her skin.

“You’re the one who picked me up. You’re the one who kept me by your side,” Amon whispered, as his feverish breath made her skin crawl, “So you have to take responsibility for me till the end, Bridey.”

Once the lovely cat was all grown up, she realized… She thought she raised him well, but she's going to be eaten up as well.

description.es:
Blondina vive la historia de Cenicienta en carne propia. Luego de una infancia pobre y atravesar una niñez difícil, descubre que es una princesa del imperio de Ates. Sin embargo, su padre y medios hermanos enajenados le dan la espalda cuando se muda al palacio y Blondina debe mantener un perfil bajo. Todo esto cambia cuando conoce a Amon, una criatura felina con intenciones misteriosas. Durante siglos, las criaturas como Amon y la humanidad han luchado para vivir en armonía. ¿Podrá la amistad entre Blondina y Amon traer la paz o acaso profundizará la brecha entre sus pares?

description.it:
Blondina, una principessa non di sangue puro, viveva isolata in un'area separata del castello. A causa del suo sangue misto, veniva maltrattata e disprezzata. Un giorno, vide un gatto nero ferito e decise di curarlo. Ma in realtà, quel bel gattino non era ciò che sembrava... "Se scappi in quel modo, avrò voglia di darti la caccia." Le labbra di Amon sfiorarono dolcemente la sua pelle. "Sei stata tu a venire da me e a tenermi al tuo fianco." Sussurrò Amon, mentre il suo respiro le faceva venire i brividi. "Quindi devi assumerti la responsabilità fino in fondo, Bridey." Quel bel gattino era cresciuto... Blondina credeva di averlo cresciuto per bene, ma sarà "divorata"...

description.pl:
Blondina, księżniczka, która ma krew pospólstwa, żyła po cichu na obrzeżach królestwa. Z powodu jej mieszanej krwi, była źle traktowana i otoczona pogardą. Pewnego dnia, napotkała się na rannego, czarnego kota i zdecydowała się mu pomóc. Jednak ten uroczy kociak, którego za takowego uważała okazał się tak naprawdę być...? "Jeśli masz zamiar uciekać w taki sposób, oczywiście, że będę chciał cię wtedy złapać." Usta Amona delikatnie powędrowały w dół jej ciała. "To ty jesteś tą, która mnie przygarnęła. To ty jesteś tą, która trzymała mnie tuż obok siebie." Wyszeptał Amon, w momencie kiedy jego rozpalony oddech przyprawił ją o dreszcze. "Więc to Ty musisz być za mnie odpowiedzialna, aż do samego końca, Bridey." Kiedy ten uroczy kociak był już dorosły, zorientowała się... Myślała, że wychowała go dobrze, jednak ona również zostanie pożarta.

description.pt-br:
Blondina, uma princesa que tinha sangue plebeu, viveu quietamente em um lugar isolado. Devido ao sangue misturado dela, ela sofreu maus tratos e foi cercada por olhares de desprezo. Um dia ela se encontra com um gato preto machucado e decide tratá-lo. Mas, o adorável gato que ela adotou na verdade era...? "Se você fugir assim é claro que eu vou querer te caçar." Os lábios do Amon gentilmente deslizaram sobre seu corpo. "Foi você quem me pegou. Você quem decidiu me manter ao seu lado." Amon sussurrou, e a sua respiração forte fez a pele dela se arrepiar toda. "Então você tem que tomar responsabilidade por mim até o fim, minha noiva." E quando o gato já estava mais crescido, ela percebeu... Ela pensou que o criou bem para ter ficado do jeito que ficou depois de crescido, mas não é bem isso...

---

description.en:
I confessed. I couldn't do it while sober so I took a shot of liquid courage.

"I like you."

"Why?"

"I just like everything about you."

"…I don't understand."

Something's strange. His voice is deeper, his height slightly different, and his physique even more so. In fact, after a closer look, even the hair colour that reflected the moonlight⁠—this is crazy. It’s someone else. It's none other than Duke Cabel Willard who's known as the 'Grim Reaper' of the battlefields.

"Cabel."

"… Excuse me?"

"From now on, don't refer to me by any strange titles. Call me by name instead."

The corners of his lips that were always frozen stiff curved into a smile. It seemed like he would immediately kill me if the truth of my false confession was brought to light.

---
"I think I’ve fallen for you." With a single drunken confession, Renesha's plans to live a comfortable and uneventful life were shattered. Somehow she confessed her love to the wrong man: the Grim Reaper of the Battlefield, Duke Cavert Willard! It's the worst thing to happen to her since she woke up in this fantasy universe and discovered her divine powers. In the midst of a war with a neighboring country, Renesha must balance her duties as a healer with her feelings for two alluring knights. When romance blooms on the battlefield, who will be victorious in the battle for Renesha's heart?

description.fr:
Je me suis confessé. Je ne pouvais pas le faire en étant sobre, alors j'ai pris une dose d'alcool fort.

«Je vous aime.»
«Pourquoi?»
«J'aime tout chez vous.»
«…Je ne comprends pas.»

Il y a quelque chose d'étrange. Sa voix est plus grave, sa taille légèrement différente, et son physique encore plus. En fait, après un examen plus approfondi, même la couleur des cheveux qui reflétait le clair de lune - c'est fou. Il s'agit de quelqu'un d'autre. Ce n'est rien d'autre que le Duc Cabel Willard qui est connu comme la «Faucheuse» des champs de bataille.

«Cabel.»
«…Excusez-moi?»
«Dorénavant, ne m'appelez plus par des titres étranges. Appelez-moi plutôt par mon nom.»

La commissure de ses lèvres, toujours figées, se recourbe en un sourire. Il semblait qu'il me tuerait immédiatement si la vérité de ma fausse confession était mise en lumière.

---
Dans les romans, lorsque l’héroïne se réincarne, elle atterrit dans le corps d’une riche demoiselle pleine de charmes. Mais pas celle-ci! Pour survivre dans ce nouveau monde fantasy, il va falloir se retrousser les manches. Et si pour cela, elle est obligée de devenir prêtresse et partir en guerre, qu’à cela ne tienne, elle relève le défi.

Я освідчусь. Я не могла зробити це в тверезому стані, тож випила порцію рідкої відваги.

"Я кохаю тебе"

«Чому?»

«Мені просто все в тобі подобається».

«…»

Щось дивне. Голос у нього глибший, зріст трохи інший, а статура ще більше. Насправді, якщо придивитися ближче, навіть колір волосся, який відбиває місячне світло⁠, — це божевілля. Це хтось інший. Це не хто інший, як герцог Кейбл Віллард, відомий як «Похмурий жнець» на полях битв.

«Кейбл».

"… Перепрошую??"

«З цього моменту клич мене на ім'я».

Завжди застиглі куточки його губ згорнулися в усмішці. Здавалося, що він негайно вб’є мене, якби правда мого помилкового освідчення була розкрита.

description.it:
“Il figlio della dea Gula è tornato.”  
  
Ero perso nel mondo del gioco d'azzardo.  
Avevo voltato le spalle alla mia famiglia e perfino tradito la mia compagna.  
Avevo sprecato ogni giorno della mia vita.  
La mia vita era spazzatura.  
La realtà mi aveva detto questo:  
Che non sarei valso nulla, qualsiasi cosa avessi fatto.  
Per cambiare la mia vita patetica, scelsi la fantasia, allora.  
Ciò nonostante, non cambiò nulla.  
Mi chiesi se avrei trovato la salvezza alla fine di questo lungo cammino.  
Ma fui obbligato ad inginocchiarmi in resa di fronte a una possente entità.  
La torre che avevo eretto con le mie mani crollò in frantumi.  
Solo per una volta, desiderai ardentemente di conoscere la verità sul mio conto.  
  
– Avvicinati, figlio mio…  
  
Questa volta non mi tirerò indietro.

“굴라(Gula)의 아들이 돌아왔다.”
 
 도박에 미쳐 살았다. 
 가족과 등을 지고, 여자 친구도 배신했다. 
 하루하루 허송세월로 보냈다. 
 쓰레기 같은 인생이었다.
 
 현실이 말했다.
 넌 뭘 해도 안 되는 놈이라고.
 비참한 현실을 바꾸려 비현실을 선택했다.
 하지만 거기서도 마찬가지.
 
 고생 끝에 낙이 오나 싶었지만, 
 커다란 세력 앞에 허무하게 무릎 꿇었다. 
 공든 탑이 물거품이 되어버렸다.
 
 한 번쯤은 진정한 자신을 알고 싶었다.
 
 -가까이 오너라, 나의 아이여.
 
 이번에는 참지 않았다.

When Seo Junho and his companions sacrificed themselves to defeat the Frost Queen, they thought they were restoring peace to Earth. But after 25 years of being frozen solid, Junho thaws out only to find that nine more floors appeared in his absence, only one of which has been cleared!

As the only one who holds the key to clearing the next floor and defrosting his friends, Junho must step up once again. But has this hero been in hibernation too long to take on the world’s fearsome new foes?

2019年世界は変わり、以前にはなかったゲート、モンスター、システム、プレイヤーのような概念が生まれた。 そこから5年間「侵略者」と「侵略を阻止する者」との戦いが世界各地で起きた。 そして世界を絶望に陥れた地球エリア最後のボス「氷の女王」により、5人のプレイヤーの内4人は氷の像となってしまう。 唯一ダンジョンに残された人類最高のプレーヤー、ダークネスは、氷の女王を倒すが、女王の能力を吸収する過程で彼もまた氷の像となった。氷の女王を倒すと、 長い眠りにつくという代価を払わなければならなかったのだー それから25年後…プレーヤーは目を覚ました。 「2階が出現し、計10階だと？1階の氷の女王を倒したら終わりじゃなかったのか？｣ この25年で人類が攻略できたのはたったの2階まで…。 伝説のプレイヤー「ダークネス」の名を捨て、新人プレーヤー伊坂圭として、仲間たちを救うため、彼は再びゲートに向かう！

В 2019 году мир переменился, и появились такие явления как: врата, монстры, система и игроки, - которых ранее не существовало. 
На протяжении 5 лет между человечеством и захватчиками происходила борьба за власть и территории.
[Финальный босс "Снежная королева" появился]
Если убить его, человечество сможет обрести свободу и вернуться к прежней жизни. 
24 ноября 2024 года четверо из 5 игроков вошли в последнее подземелье на Антарктиде, чтобы победить финального босса на территории Земли. Одним взмахом руки "Снежная королева" заморозила Тихий океан, повергнув человечество в отчаяние. 
Последнему игроку удалось победить финального босса, однако в процессе поглощения ее "ядра" он превратился в ледяную глыбу. А спустя 25 лет, когда поглощение завершилось, он очнулся от криогенного сна, получив фрост-способность EX-класса.

description.en:
1-Star heroes are just fodder for learning a boss' attack patterns.

That was Seojin Han's philosophy when playing the notoriously difficult game Pick Me Up. But after being transported into the game as one of those 1-star heroes, he's got no choice but to rise in rank and defeat the player controlling him and his party.

Can a gacha game character hope to defeat a player akin to being his god?
description.ja: 高難易度で悪名高いモバイルガチャゲームで、世界ランキング5位の凄腕プレイヤー、ロキがダンジョン攻略中に意識を失ってしまう。「え？俺がゲームのキャラに？」目覚めると、ロキはなんとレベル1、星1つのヒーロー、ハン・イスラットになっていた。元の世界に戻るため、彼は新米マスターとヒーローたちを率いて、ダンジョンの100階層をクリアしなければならない。「俺を怒らせたな」。決して敗北を認めないマスター、ロキによる、最強のキャリーが始まる！
description.pt-br:
No jogo de gacha mobile famoso por sua extrema dificuldade, o Mestre classificado em 5º lugar no mundo, "Loki" perde a consciência ao invadir a Masmorra.

"O quê? Eu sou um personagem de jogo agora?"

Depois de acordar, "Loki" percebe que ele se transformou em um Herói de Nível 1, 1 Estrela – 'Han Yslat'. Para retornar à Terra, ele deve liderar o Mestre e os heróis novatos e limpar o 100º andar da Masmorra!

"Você mexeu com o cara errado".

Esta é a história de transporte mais difícil  pelo Mestre Loki que nunca aceita uma única derrota.
description.zh-hk: 故事圍繞一款號稱有著無人能完整攻略的地下城，以地獄級難度著稱的抽卡手遊《Pick me up!》。而被稱為大師中的大師，排名全球第5的玩家「洛基」，在攻略地下城的過程中失去了意識，並在醒來後發現自己成了《Pick me up!》中的英雄——類別、等級皆為1級的「韓．伊斯拉特」。「這一定是那傢伙幹的。是那傢伙把我拖進來的！」為了重回地球，洛基必須要帶領新手大師和眾多英雄攻略100層的地下城！「你——惹錯人了。」這是來自大師洛基的強行助攻，且容不下半點失誤！

description.en:
After Sirone was abandoned in a stable, he was found by a family of hunters and raised in a loving home. 

Despite the hardships of the peasant life, he learned how to read from a young age and became obsessed with books, especially ones on the history of magic. One day, he has an unlikely encounter with a mage and learns how to enter the "spirit zone," the first step to learning how to use magic. 

Although they say only nobles can be mages, will Sirone be able to prove his infinite potential?

description.ru:
Однажды, далеко в горах, в конюшне раздался детский плач… Кто-то оставил там маленького ребёнка, которого в итоге приютила крестьянская семья дровосека.
Мальчика назвали Широн. Он был удивительно умён и талантлив: в отличие от других детей простолюдинов, он умел читать и писать, и в один день в его руки попала книга о магии, предопределившая его дальнейшую судьбу — Широн во что бы то ни стало решил стать волшебником. Но удастся ли обычному мальчику исполнить эту мечту в жестоком и запутанном мире, который его окружает?
description.th:

แต่เนื่องจากเป็นสามัญชนเขาจึงหมดโอกาสนั้นไปอย่างสิ้นเชิง

description.en:
After the fall of the empire due to the homunculi, Evienrose, the 7th Princess, dies after drinking poison given by her younger sister who has taken their side. When she opens her eyes again, she has returned 8 years to the past. To stop the fall of the imperial family, Eve decides to turn 'Mikhael', the leader of the homunculi and the 'Monster of the Floating Prison', into her appointed knight.

"Mikhael, I need you, very much."

---
Princess Evienrose, despite advocating fiercely for the rights of the homunculi rebels, now awaits death at their hands… that is until she is poisoned by her own sister! Awakening eight years in the past, Eve now has one goal: become the Empress and liberate the homunculi to stop the rebellion from ever happening! To do this, she appoints the rebel king himself, Mikaelis Agnito, as her personal knight. But with Eve’s scheming sisters standing in the way, the fight for the crown is on, and the fate of the Hadelamid empire rests in her hands!

---
The seventh imperial princess, Evenrose, once died. Her last memory was of the royal family was destroyed by the Homunculus, the rebelling slaves, and of her sister who had sided with the rebels and urged her to escape her painful execution by swallowing poison. But when she opened her eyes again, "I...I'm not dead." She realizes that she had gone eight years back in time, back to a time before her cruel sister Bridgette was chosen as the next emperor. Given the opportunity to prevent the fall of the imperial family by being chosen as the next emperor herself, she decides to write her own article about Michael, the king of Homunculus and the monster of public prison, in order to win the emperor's heart. "I need you, Michael. Very badly." Will Evenrose be able to get him and protect the imperial family safely?

---

description.es:
La séptima princesa imperial, Evenrose, murió una vez.Su último recuerdo fue cuando la familia real fue destruida por el Homúnculo, quien provocó la traición y se ahogó en el plan de su hermano parado de su lado, al tragar veneno. Pero cuando volvió a abrir los ojos,"Yo ... no estoy muerto."Se da cuenta de que ha vuelto al pasado y que era ocho años más joven. Fue antes de que el tercer emperador, que será el próximo heredero, fuera elegido oficialmente como sucesor. Una oportunidad para evitar la caída de la familia imperial presionando al tercer emperador Bridgette y siendo reconocida como sucesora. Como parte de la preparación, Evenrose decidió escribir su propio artículo sobre Michael, el rey de Homunculus y el monstruo de la prisión pública, para ganarse el corazón del emperador."Te necesito, Michael. description.fr:
Il était une fois, un royaume où grâce à une alchimie interdite, des homonculus étaient créés.

Ces homonculus devaient se soumettre à la volonté de la famille Impériale à l’aide d’une magie d’asservissement. Les plus doués d’entre eux faisaient partie de la garde du château et parmi eux, la famille Impériale devait en choisir un pour en faire leur chevalier personnel. Mais un homonculus résista au sort de l’Empereur: Mikhaelis Agnito.

Il organisa une rébellion, souleva les homonculus contre l’empire et exécuta toute la famille Impériale à l’exception de la 7ᵉ princesse, Evenrose et la 8ᵉ princesse, Rosenite. Cette dernière, éperdument amoureuse de Mikhaelis, croyait qu’elle portait en elle le «résultat de leur amour.» Elle pensait être exceptionnelle mais elle n’était en vie qu’uniquement parce qu’elle avait subit une expérience avec la pierre philosophale, qui ne fonctionnait seulement qu’avec le sang royal. Une simple marionnette que Mikhaelis pouvait contrôler à sa guise.

Cependant, le traître avait des sentiments pour Evenrose, car elle était différente. Elle était contre l’utilisation des homonculus comme esclaves et étudia durement pour leur rendre leur liberté, faisant d’elle le mouton noir de la famille Impériale. Malheureusement, elle ne comprit pas les actions de Mikhaelis et croyait qu’elle allait se faire exécuter comme les siens.
Rosenite en profita pour venir la voir et l’empoisonner, se réjouissant de la mort de sa demi-sœur, pensant avoir Mikhaelis pour elle seule. En apprenant la nouvelle de la mort d’Evenrose, Mikhaelis tente alors par tous les moyens de la ressusciter. Un mage lui proposa un moyen: celui de retourner dans le temps. Néanmoins, seule Evenrose gardera les souvenirs de tout ce qui c’était passé jusqu’à présent. Mikhaelis accepta sans sourciller, du moment que sa bien aimée était en vie. Quand le sort se lança, Evenrose ouvrit les yeux et se retrouva 8 ans en arrière.

Sera-t-elle capable de changer son destin?

description.de: Eines Tages bin ich plötzlich als Schurkin in einem Roman aufgewacht ... nun gilt es, dem männlichen Protagonisten aus dem Weg zu gehen, um zu überleben!
description.en:
I was poor and with no one looking out for me, I was struggling financially. Because of this, I had trouble adjusting to school as well.  
  
My only hobby was reading a fantasy web novel <The Fake Lovers of the Academy> and imagining that I could become the main character of it. One day, after falling asleep and imagining this as usual… I woke up but instead of becoming the heroine, I'd become the villainess, Louise Sweeney, who meets a terrible ending.  
  
"Since I know the original novel, if I just avoid falling in love at first sight with the male lead, I definitely won't have a tragic ending!" Thinking this, Louise avoids the male lead.  
  
But what's this…? Unlike the original novel, the male lead passionately confesses his love to Louise, and the heroine, who she believed to be kind, has it in for her…?!  
  
How did this happen? Wasn't it supposed to all work out if I just avoided the male lead?!

---
Waking up inside your favorite novel sounds like a dream come true. Unless you’re born as the hated villainess, that is. Our new, full-fledged Louise Sweeny must try to reinvent her character to dodge her doomed fate of being killed off at the end of the story. It seemed easy enough at first, but there’s one big problem. The story, which she knew like the back of her hand, has veered so far off course that she can’t predict what plot twists are coming next. Can she avoid getting in the way of the male and female leads’ romance to save herself from impending demise?
description.es: Un día, abrí los ojos y desperté en el cuerpo de la villana de mi novela favorita. Para sobrevivir, ¡debo evitar a toda costa al príncipe que protagoniza la novela!
description.fr: Un jour, quand j'ai ouvert les yeux, je me suis réincarnée en vilaine de mon roman préféré. Pour survivre, je dois à tout prix éviter le prince qui est le protagoniste du roman!
description.id: Aku hidup kembali di dalam dunia novel sebagai seorang Antagonis?! Untuk tetap hidup di sini, aku harus menghindari sang tokoh utama! Tapi, kenapa dia malah jadi semakin dekat denganku?!
description.ko:
[과거의 나는 잊어라! 가난했던 과거는 잊고 루이스 스위니로서 새로 시작하는 거야!] 

가난하고 챙겨주는 이 없어 경제적으로 많이 궁핍했던 나.  
그 때문인지 학교생활도 잘 적응하지 못했다.  

유일한 취미는 판타지 웹소설 <아카데미의 연인>을 읽으며 자신이 주인공이 되는 상상을 하는 것이다. 
여느 날과 다름없이 상상을 하며 잠이 들었는데…. 눈을 뜨니 주인공이 아닌 처참한 말로를 맞는 악녀 루이스 스위니로 환생을 해버렸다…?!  

‘원작을 알고 있으니 남자 주인공에게 첫 눈에 반하는 일만 피한다면 절대 비극적으로 끝나지 않을 거야!’ 
그런 생각을 하며 남자 주인공을 피해 다니는 루이스. 

그런데 이게 웬걸…? 원작과 다르게 남자 주인공은 루이스에게 열렬한 구애를 하고  
착하다고 믿었던 여자 주인공은 루이스를 못 잡아 먹어서 안달인데…?! 

이게 어떻게 된 거지? 남자 주인공만 피해 다니면 되는 거 아니었어?! 

그녀를 둘러싼 <아카데미의 연인> 원작 등장인물들의 마법 같은 이야기! 
찬란한 인생 제2막이 시작된다!
description.ru: Проснуться в своём любимом романе - мечта, ставшая реальностью. Если только ты не попала в тело ненавистной злодейки. Наша новая, Луиза Суини должна преодолеть характер злодейки и изменить сюжет, дабы избежать печальный конец истории. Поначалу всё казалось простым, но есть одна большая проблема. История, которую она знала как свои пять пальцев, изменилась настолько, что больше не может предсказать, какие повороты сюжета будут следующими. Сможет ли она не помешать отношениям главных героев, чтобы спасти себя от неминуемой гибели?
description.th: ได้เกิดใหม่ในโลกนิยายที่ชอบทั้งที ดันมาเกิดเป็นตัวร้ายที่มีจุดจบน่าเศร้าซะนี่ ฉันจึงต้องพยายามใช้ชีวิตอย่างดี เพื่อหลีกหนีจากชะตากรรมอันเลวร้าย แต่ดูเหมือนอะไรๆ จะผิดเพี้ยนไปหมด ทั้งพระเอกพระรองที่ควรจะรักนางเอก ดันมาตกหลุมรักฉันซะงั้น! ไม่ได้นะ! ฉันเป็นแค่ "เพื่อนสาวของพระเอก" เท่านั้นนะ!
description.zh:

description.en:
I’d been reincarnated as the heroine of a predictable third-rate harem novel. I decided to live as the heroine and enjoy my comfortable life with the hero… but what kind of romance is this?! Having a soldier for a boyfriend, there was a constant stream of women surrounding him… and all kinds of incidents occurred. So now I was trying my best to live a normal life. I broke up with my boyfriend and married a man I’d met during a blind date but… What? My husband is the demon king?

“Ha, what do you have your guard up for? Are you scared that I’m going to do something to you? I can see that you’re scared.”

“Why would I be scared?”

“What?”

“What would you be able to do to me? Don’t flatter yourself, I’m just uncomfortable.”

“I want you to be mine, but that seems to be impossible.”

…. No matter how much I think about this, everything seems to be wrong.

---
Some women would kill to be the love interest of a book’s charming protagonist, but Maise Hazelnut is different! As a girl from the 21st century, she struggles to keep up the appearance of the angelic “Maise” while defying the fate laid out for her by a harem romance novel. That’s right, Maise’s boyfriend is none other than the goofy and lovable protagonist, and every woman in the book has her eyes on him. Right after she dumps him to work toward her own happy ending, Maise gets set up on a blind date with a man named Eith Lancell. She falls head over heels for Eith, but notices his strange behavior at times… Something’s weird about this devilishly handsome new beau. What could he be hiding?

description.en:
Pollyanna is an unremarkable girl in a noble family. Her parents send her to military conscription hoping she'll die quickly in battle. Left only with her wits and her strength, Pollyanna fights to rise up in the ranks. One day, she meets an ardent king, one who finally acknowledges her worth. Moved by his dream for unity, Pollyanna vows to fight for him. But now the young king is slowly realizing this stalwart knight has also conquered his heart.

---
After six years of pointless war between her country, the Kingdom of Ehas, and their neighbor enemies, the Kingdom of Cukda, aged 20, the woman soldier and former petty officer Pauliana Kellenbell has been defeated and captured in a storming attack by the army of another enemy nation, the Kingdom of Acrea, an attack she had personally predicted but fell on deaf ears by her superiors. She has been desperately trying to survive in men's society, but it was all in vain, her noble birthright having been taken away by her family by being sent to war, and having all her efforts crushed down by the fact that she's a woman in the all-male army of Ehas.

Acrea's young king, Lucius, sees her struggle and potential, and makes an unexpected offer. He dreams of becoming the first emperor to conquer the South continent and its sea. Pauliana swears a life-long allegiance to Lucius for acknowledging her, becoming his knight and most trusted advisor, bestowing her with the name Pauliana Winter. However, in the end, Lucius is just an emperor on the battlefield that had awakened his love for Pauliana!

description.de: Nach einem Autounfall wird Yiyeong Kim als S-Rang-Hunter in einem Fantasyroman wiedergeboren. Mühevoll bahnt sie sich ihren Weg bis zum Endgegner vor, doch als sie ihn endlich besiegt hat, kehrt sie nicht wie erwartet nach Hause zurück. Stattdessen landet sie gleich im nächsten Roman – diesmal aber im Körper der schurkischen Lady Renee Markios, die zurzeit des Mordes bezichtigt wird.
description.en:
S-class Hunter Kim Yiyoung can't wait to leave the novel she woke up in. She gets the chance after defeating the story's final boss, but instead of returning home, she's sent into another novel! Yiyoung becomes Lady Renee Markious, a petty villainess who's just been framed for murder. Fortunately, Yiyoung has a secret weapon nobody knows about… her skills from her past life! Can Yiyoung clear Renee's name and find her way back to her own world? Or will she be trapped in this tale for good?

---
"I'm done with romance, so send me home!"

Kim Yi-Young was just an ordinary civil service exam candidate in South Korea.
After studying for more than four and a half years, she finally passed, a truly ordinary person with nothing but reading novels here and there as a hobby.

However, on the day she went out for a celebratory meal after passing the exam, she got into a traffic accident and died, only to find herself reincarnated into the fantasy hunter novel she was reading.

To her, the "System" offered a way back home.
Determined solely to return home and cuddle her warm cat and adorable Maltese, Cerberus, she gained strength through dozens of regressions.

Signing contracts with the constellations of the original work and dying multiple times, she eventually succeeded in conquering the "Tower" of the original work and defeating the owner of the tower on the final floor.

Now, all that's left is to go home......

Or so she thought!

[Due to an error, instead of returning to the original world, we will reincarnate you into the author's new work!]

I don't need that! All I wanted was my sweet home! Is that so difficult?! I even got rid of the Tower!?

Moreover, romance fantasy?! Even in my previous life, I didn't care about romance, not one bit!
And to top it off, I didn't even reincarnate into my own body this time, but into the "villainess" of the book!

I'm not afraid of the threats in this world, but I'm worried about being forced into a romance quest.

"Can I go home...?"
description.fr: Kim Yiyoung, chasseuse de classe S, est impatiente de quitter le roman dans lequel elle s'est réveillée. Elle en a l'occasion après avoir vaincu le boss final de l'histoire, mais au lieu de rentrer chez elle, elle est envoyée dans un autre roman! Yiyoung devient Lady Renée Markierus, une petite vilaine qui vient d'être accusée de meurtre. Heureusement, Yiyoung a une arme secrète que personne ne connaît... ses compétences acquises dans sa vie passée! Yiyoung pourra-t-elle laver le nom de Renée et retrouver son monde? Ou sera-t-elle piégée dans ce conte pour de bon?
description.ko:
**로맨스는 됐으니까 집에나 보내줘!**
김이영, 그녀는 대한민국의 평범한 공무원 시험 응시생이었다.
그것도 4년 반이 넘는 긴 시간동안 공부 끝에 합격한, 낙이라고는 짬짬이 소설읽는 것밖에 없는 정말 평범한 사람.

그러나 합격을 축하하기 위해 외식을 나간 날 교통사고를 당해 죽고, 자신이 읽던 현태판타지 헌터물에 빙의하고 만다.
그런 이영에게 집으로 돌아갈 수 있는 길을 제안하는 '시스템'.
그녀는 오로지 집에 돌아가서 배 따땃하게 지지고 귀여운 말티즈 켈베로스를 끌어안겠다는 일념 하에 수십 번씩 회귀하며 힘을 길렀다.
원작 속의 성좌들과 계약하고 수차례 죽어가며 원작 속의 '탑'을 공략하여 결국 마지막 층의 지배자, 탑의 주인을 처리하는 데 성공한다. 

이제 남은 건 집으로 가는 것 뿐……,


인줄 알았는데!

[오류로 인해 원래 세상으로의 복귀 대신, 작가의 신작에 빙의시켜드리겠습니다!]

필요 없어! 내가 바란건 내 스윗 홈뿐이었는데!
그게 그렇게 어려워?! 탑도 내가 없애줬는데?!?!

게다가, 로맨스 판타지라니! 이전 빙의에서도 로맨스의 ㄹ도, 아니, ㄹ의 한 획도 신경 안 쓰고 살았는데!
거기에 이전처럼 내 몸으로 책에 빙의한 게 아니라 책 속의 '악녀'에 빙의했다!

이 세계의 위협은 전혀 두렵지 않지만, 로맨스를 강제로 끌어내는 퀘스트는 걱정된다. 

나, 집에 갈 수 있을까……?
description.pl:
Transmigrowała do powieści fantasy o konstelacji łowców, a po 10 latach w końcu osiągnęła ranking łowcy nr 1. i oczyściła wieżę... Ale teraz transmigrowała do powieści romantyczno-fantasy jako wywyższona i niesławnie zła księżniczka?

【"Vicious Blood Cult" pyta, gdzie się znajdujemy】
【Monarcha Fal i Uzdrowienia jest zdezorientowany】
【"Władca Pokus" jest zachwycony znajomym światem】

Ale jeśli przyjrzeć się bliżej, ta księżniczka zwykle nie wiedzie tak złego życia, prawda? Każdego dnia dochodzi do zamachów i różnego rodzaju intryg...

【Umiejętność "Vicious Blood Cult" "Unsinkable Poison" LV.999 oczyszcza truciznę mandragory!】
【Umiejętność "Błogosławieństwo Wody" LV.999 Monarchy Fal i Uzdrowienia doskonale leczy rany!】
【Umiejętność Władcy Pokus "Pokusa Snu" LV.999 usypia zabójcę!】

Ale co tam. Wszystko jest takie nudne w porównaniu do mojego poprzedniego życia. Planowałam spokojnie wykonywać swoje misje, delektując się chwilami, kiedy będę mogła zrobić sobie przerwę i odpocząć, Ale teraz jej starsi bracia i główny bohater, którzy wcześniej dręczyli złoczyńcę, zaczęli mnie śledzić... Zemszczę się za ciebie i dam ci wszystko, czego chcesz, więc cholerny systemie, proszę, odeślij mnie z powrotem do domu!
description.pt-br:
**Estou farta de romance, então me mandem para casa!**

Kim Yi-Young era apenas uma candidata comum ao exame de serviço civil na Coreia do Sul. Depois de estudar por mais de quatro anos e meio, finalmente passou, uma pessoa verdadeiramente comum que só gostava de ler romances de vez em quando como passatempo.

No entanto, no dia em que saiu para uma refeição comemorativa após passar no exame, sofreu um acidente de trânsito e morreu, apenas para se ver reencarnada no romance de caçadora de fantasia que estava lendo.

Para ela, o "Sistema" ofereceu um caminho de volta para casa. Determinada apenas a voltar para casa e abraçar seu gato e o adorável Maltês, Cerberus, ela ganhou força através de dezenas de regressões. Assinando contratos com as constelações da obra original e morrendo várias vezes, eventualmente conseguiu conquistar a "Torre" da obra original e derrotar o dono da torre no último andar.

Agora, tudo o que resta é voltar para casa......

Ou pelo menos era o que ela pensava!

[Devido a um erro, em vez de retornar ao mundo original, vamos reencarná-la na nova obra do autor!]

Eu não preciso disso! Tudo o que eu queria era minha doce casa! É tão difícil assim?! Até me livrei da Torre!?!?!

Além disso, fantasia romântica?! Nem mesmo na minha vida anterior eu me importava com romance, nem um pouco! E para piorar, nem reencarnei em meu próprio corpo desta vez, mas na "vilã" do livro!

Não tenho medo das ameaças deste mundo, mas estou preocupada em ser forçada a uma busca romântica.

Será que posso voltar para casa......?

description.en:
Angela's fanfic became such a sensation that it even reached the Imperial Family, leading her to get arrested on charges of treason. Nevertheless, her fanfic improved the First Prince's image, and his sister, the Princess, decides to take political advantage of this and keep Angela by their side. The heroine who can now fangirl to her heart's content, and the Prince who doesn't know how to act around her. As they bicker back and forth, they start growing closer…

---
Angela is mortified when her cringey fanfic about the dethroned Prince Rayburn is published behind her back and becomes a wildly popular bestseller. Not only is it super embarrassing, but the book gets her in trouble with the current imperial family, who now want her head for treason!

Luckily, Rayburn's sister Hoya offers to protect her-- but in exchange, she must write a sequel that will improve Rayburn's tarnished reputation. But that's easier said than done, when the scary prince already hates her for writing the first novel. Will Angela be able to chip away at Rayburn's cold exterior and gather enough inspiration for her next book?

description.en:
Lady Adrianna isn't just a noblewoman, she's the side character in "Ramona's Tale," the favorite novel of an ill peasant girl who died tragically young. This is her second chance at life, and she's not reliving that tragedy!

An evil stepmother's not gonna stop her, and Rian slowly gathers handsome companions along the way... the calculating imperial prince, the friendly count, the mysterious and brooding demon prince.

After all, she is determined to live a long, healthy, and wealthy life!


---
description.fr:
« Je suis né avec une cuillère en or dans la bouche mais je suis misérablement assassiné? Je vais survivre complètement et vivre une longue vie ! »  
  
Je me suis réincarné en tant que sœur cadette du personnage roman de ma préférée qui est destinée à être empoisonnée par sa belle-mère à l'âge de dix-sept ans. Mon frère part à l'aventure avec l'héroïne, je dois donc survivre seul. Devrions-nous commencer par des plans de survie? Tout d'abord, assurez-vous de me comporter avec ma belle-mère et ma belle-sœur. Deuxièmement, devenez proche des enfants de familles influentes. Troisièmement, est-ce que… euh… se marie?  
  
Pour échapper au sort d'une mort misérable, moi, Adriana, je commence à approcher le prince de l'Empire, le maître suspect et le démon suspect!  


---
description.ru:
«Я родилась богатой аристократкой, но меня должны убить? Нельзя этого допустить! Я точно выживу и проживу долгую жизнь!» Я переродилась в младшую сестру героя моего любимого романа, которому суждено было быть отравленным ее мачехой в возрасте семнадцати лет. Мой брат был в это время с героиней, поэтому я должна найти сама способ, как-то выжить. Может стоит начать с составления плана выживания? Во-первых, будем слушаться во всем мачеху и сводную сестру. Во-вторых, сблизиться с детьми из влиятельных семей. В-третьих, может быть… экхем… выйти замуж?

---

description.de: Die Welt verfällt in Panik, als 120 Millionen Spieler des beliebten VR-Spiels Eternal World eines Tages spurlos verschwinden. Einige Monate später kehren sie einer nach dem anderen zurück, nachdem sie im Spiel gestorben sind. Aber sie sind nicht die Einzigen, die zurückkommen: Auch Monster erscheinen plötzlich und richten Chaos auf der Erde an. Alle Hoffnung scheint verloren, bis der maskierte Monarch, der stärkste Spieler von Eternal World, zurückkehrt. Im Handumdrehen versammelt er sein altes Team, um die Bestien und den ruchlosen Dämonenkönig ein für alle Mal zu besiegen. Aber von Menschenhand gefertigte Waffen sind nutzlos gegen die Gegner, die es zu bekämpfen gilt, und die Spieler haben Schwierigkeiten, ohne die besonderen Items und Belohnungen des Spiels hochzuleveln. Der maskierte Monarch hat ein paar Asse im Ärmel, aber werden sie ausreichen, um die Welt zu retten?
description.en:
The world falls into a state of panic when 120 million players of a popular VR game, Eternal World, vanish without a trace one day. A few months later, they begin returning one by one after dying in the game.

But they’re not the only ones to make it back - monsters also start to appear and wreak havoc on Earth. All hope seems lost until the Masked Monarch, the most powerful player of Eternal World, returns.

He quickly assembles his old team back together to defeat the beasts and the nefarious Demon King once and for all. But man-made weapons are useless against the enemies they must fight, and players are struggling to level up without the game’s special items or rewards.

The Masked Monarch has a few tricks up his sleeve, but will they be enough to save the world?


- [Original Webtoon <Webtoon kakao>](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%82%98-%ED%98%BC%EC%9E%90-%EB%A7%8C%EB%A0%99-%EA%B7%80%ED%99%98%EC%9E%90/2431)
description.fr: Le monde entier commence à céder à la panique lorsque 120 millions de joueurs d'un célèbre jeu VR, Eternal World, disparaissent sans laisser de traces. Quelques mois plus tard, la situation empire lorsque d'étranges créatures font leur apparition et commencent à massacrer la population. Heureusement, les mystérieux disparus font progressivement leur retour et rétablissent l'équilibre en aidant à éliminer ces monstres, sortis du monde d'Eternal World. Mais l'accalmie est de courte durée puisque le flot de créatures ne décroît pas, et pire encore... elles deviennent de plus en plus puissantes. Tout espoir semble finalement inutile, jusqu'à ce que le fameux Monarque Masqué fasse lui aussi son retour. Il décide alors de monter un groupe pour se débarrasser des monstres et du roi des démons une bonne fois pour toute. Seulement, les armes et les compétences sont limitées dans le monde réel, et malgré les nombreux atouts que le Monarque a dans sa manche, cela sera-t-il suffisant pour vaincre les ennemis qui lui font face ?

description.en:
Eleven year old Siwoo Jeong can only play by himself during gym class.

"I'm sitting out."

"Why are you the only one sitting out?"

"Are you kidding?"

"If I go in, everybody else has to sit out. Physically."

To Siwoo, strength isn't something he's had to train for, but something that's come naturally. When he turned sixteen years old though, the world undergoes a catastrophic change. A floating castle appeared in the sky and, through its choosing, granted people wings to become players. The world had been changed forever. Now, ten years have passed. Despite his incredible strength, Siwoo was not chosen as a player and had lived bumming around, until he saves the life of Irene Su falling from the sky, and is granted access to an underground dungeon as a new player. He's more special than anyone! The herculean Siwoo's dungeon run begins now!

---
26-year-old Jung Si-woo never had any friends, because there was nothing interesting about him. He lived an average life as an average person in an average world. But suddenly, the earth faced a great change when Mysterious floating 'Sky Castles' appeared. The 'Sky Castles' granted some people wings and powers, but unfortunately, Si-woo wasn't one of them.

description.ko:
11살 정시우는 항상 체육 시간에 혼자 노는 수밖에 없었다.
“난 구기 열외야.”
“왜 너만 열외야? 장난하냐?”
“내가 나가면 나머지 인원이 전부 열외되거든. 물리적으로.”
정시우에게 있어 힘이란 갈고닦는 것이 아닌 타고나는 것이었다.


그런 그가 열여섯이 되었을 때
세계는 대격변을 맞이하게 된다.

지구 상공에 나타난 거대한 성과
성의 선택으로 날개를 얻은 플레이어들.

그들은 세계를 변화시키고 말았다.

그렇게 10년.
정작 특별 힘의 소유자인 정시우는 플레이어가 되지 못한 채 백수 라이프를 만끽하던 중,
하늘에서 추락하던 수아린을 살리면서 들어가게 된 지하 던전에서

description.de:
Als Sua eines Tages in der Welt ihres Lieblingsromans in der Rolle von Blair aufwacht, ist sie fest entschlossen, dem weiblichen Hauptcharakter Chloe zu helfen, die schwierigste Phase ihres Lebens zu überstehen. Seit Jahren wird Chloe diskriminiert und misshandelt, weil sie ein uneheliches Kind ist. Blair wird zu ihrem Dienstmädchen und zu ihrer Vertrauten und die zwei entwickeln eine besondere Freundschaft. Aber es stellt sich heraus, dass Chloe völlig anders ist, als im eigentlichen Roman dargestellt. Sie benutzt schwarze Magie, beauftragt Blair, ihr mysteriöse Tränke zu besorgen, und scheint keinerlei Interesse an den männlichen Hauptcharakteren zu haben. Dann erscheint eines Tages ein gut aussehender Mann vor Blairs Haustür, der Chloe zum Verwechseln ähnlich sieht. Könnte das ... die Lady sein, der sie gedient hat?! Alles scheint möglich, als die Geschichte von Liebe und Erlösung eine überraschende Wendung nach der anderen nimmt.

description.en:
It has been four years since the original heroine ended her life as a maid. A handsome man came to see her. He was a man who looked like the young lady that she used to serve.

"I'm here to keep my promise, Blair. You said that you'd be with me for the rest of your life."

"No way… Young Miss?"

At that moment, the man's crimson eyes turned to meet mine. He bent down till our noses nearly touched and kissed my hair.

And whispered — in a very sweet and beautiful voice —

"You have to call me Young Master now."

…Huh?

---
When Su-A wakes up inside the world of her favorite novel as the character of Blair, she is determined to help the female protagonist, Chloe, get through the darkest period of her life. 

For years, Chloe has had to endure discrimination and abuse for being an illegitimate child. Blair becomes her maid and confidante, and the two form a special friendship. But Chloe turns out to be quite a different character than the one described in the book. She wields black magic, sends Blair to fetch her mysterious potions, and seems totally uninterested in any of the male lead candidates. Then one day, a handsome man who looks an awful lot like Chloe shows up at Blair’s doorstep. Could it be…the lady she used to serve?! 

All bets are off as plot twist after plot twist unravels in this unpredictable tale of love and redemption.

---

description.fr:
Lorsque Sua se réveille soudain dans le monde de son roman préféré, dans le corps du personnage de Blair, elle est bien décidée à aider l’héroïne de l’histoire, Chloé, à surmonter la période la plus sombre de sa vie. Pendant des années, Chloé a dû endurer discrimination et abus, simplement parce qu’elle est une enfant illégitime. Blair devient alors sa servante et confidente, et une amitié toute particulière se forme. Mais voilà que Chloé s’avère être bien différente du personnage décrit dans le roman… Elle pratique la magie noire, envoie Blair chercher de mystérieuses potions, et semble totalement inintéressée par les personnages masculins qui l’entourent. Puis un beau jour, un charmant jeune homme ressemblant extrêmement à Chloé fait son apparition devant la porte de Blair. Se pourrait-il vraiment que ce soit… la demoiselle qu’elle servait? C’est ce qu’il reste à découvrir dans cette histoire d’amour et de rédemption pleine de retournements et d’imprévus!

description.ru:
*Это не юри!*

Я не работала горничной уже 4 года. Но однажды у моего дома неожиданно появился красивый мужчина, очень похожий на леди, которой я когда-то служила.

-Я приехал, чтобы исполнить обещание. Ты говорила, что останешься со мной навсегда.

-Не может быть… Госпожа?

В этот момент его красные глаза слегка округлились. Он наклонил голову, поцеловал локон моих волос и нежно прошептал:

-Теперь зови меня "господин."

Khi tỉnh dậy trong thế giới của cuốn tiểu thuyết yêu thích với tư cách là Blair, nữ chính đã quyết tâm giúp Chloe, nữ chính nguyên tác vượt qua thời kỳ đen tối nhất trong cuộc đời cô. Chloe đã phải chịu sự kỳ thị và ngược đãi vì là con ngoài giá thú nhiều năm liền. Blair trở thành người giúp việc và người bạn tâm giao của cô, giữa hai người sau đó hình thành một tình bạn đặc biệt. Nhưng Chloe hóa ra là một nhân vật hoàn toàn khác so với những gì được mô tả trong cuốn sách. Cô ấy sử dụng ma thuật đen, cử Blair đi lấy những lọ thuốc bí ẩn. Ngoài ra, Chloe dường như hoàn toàn không quan tâm đến bất kỳ ứng cử viên nam chính nào. Đến một ngày, một người đàn ông đẹp trai trông rất giống Chloe xuất hiện trước cửa nhà Blair. Người đó… là cô tiểu thư Blair từng phục vụ đó sao?!

description.en: Leah Hildebrandt was a strong knight who fought and served her country well— leading her troops to many victories. After the death of her parents, Leah now leads her life as the eldest daughter of the Hildebrandt family and is well known In society for her beautiful appearance and good manners. The only problem is that her brother, Richt, who was the heir to the family, left one day leaving behind a letter saying that he will return once he becomes a great man. Since it’s not known whether Richt is dead or alive, Leah decided to find a political marriage partner to retain her family’s position. However, something that starts as a mere political trick turns out to be fate!

description.en:
Do Kyunwoo is the black sheep of his renowned swordsman family. He cannot even catch a rabbit on his own. On his first day of fifth grade, he meets a tranfer student and recalls his past life.

He had reincarnated into the world of a game he used to play called [Brave Hearts]. He was already frustrated that he had reincarnated as a loser, but on top of that, the transfer student is an intermediate/mid-tier boss who will destroy the world!

“Why are you being so nice to me?”

“Because I want to be friends with you.”

Do Kyunwoo’s plan is to become friends with the transfer student in order to prevent the end of the world!

In order to survive in this new world and to reach an ending he desires. He becomes best friends with the mid level boss.

description.en:
Ed Rothstaylor is a third-rate villain in a game, disowned by his family and kicked out of the dormitory for his misdeeds. One day, our main character wakes up as this very Ed, and realizes he must earn a scholarship so he can graduate and be set for life. 

Now living in the woods, he resolves to keep away from the protagonists, but four of the female leads just won't leave him alone. Not only that, his presence starts to change the timeline and events of the game! 

Can Ed help the story progress while staying out of the limelight?

---
***Note:** LINE Webtoon (Official English) has made changes to the main character's "original emotional facial expressions" in some chapters like for examples, CH.01, CH.02 and CH.06 is changed while it's kept in all other official language platforms.*
description.fr: Après avoir fini son jeu préféré «L'Épéiste raté de Sylvania» plus de cinq fois, un joueur se retrouve aspiré au début de l'histoire pour la recommencer dans le rôle ingrat d'un méchant personnage secondaire, détesté de tous et renié par sa famille, avec lequel il devra composer pour survivre à l'académie!
description.id: Kehidupanku berubah saat menjadi tokoh antagonis ekstra game favoritku. Padahal aku hanya ingin hidup santai tanpa ambisi, tapi sulit sekali bertahan di dunia ini. Pokoknya aku harus bertahan hidup dengan cara yang tak terbayangkan oleh para pemeran utama!
description.it: Ed Rothstaylor è un antagonista di terza categoria, ripudiato dalla sua famiglia e cacciato dai dormitori per i suoi misfatti. Un giorno, il nostro protagonista si sveglia nei panni di questo stesso Ed, e realizza di dover ottenere una borsa di studio così da potersi diplomare ed essere sistemato per il resto della sua vita. Costretto a vivere nei boschi, decide di stare alla larfa dai protagonisti, ma quattro delle ragazze principali non vogliono lasciarlo in pace. Non solo questo, la sua presenza inizia ad alterare la linea temporale e gli eventi del gioco! Riuscirà Ed ad aiutare la storia a proseguire, mentre si tiene lontano dai riflettori?
description.ja: 好きだったゲームの三流エキストラ悪役に転生してしまった。 野望はなく、ただおとなしく暮らしたい。しかしこの世は、生き残るのが本当に大変だ。 主人公にはできない三流悪役のやり方で、俺はこの物語の結末を迎えるために生き残るぞ！
description.ko:
즐겨하던 게임의 삼류 엑스트라 악역으로 빙의했다.
야망은 없고 그냥 조용히 살고 싶다. 근데 세상이 참 살아남기 힘들다.
주인공이 할 수 없는 삼류 악역의 방식으로, 난 이 이야기의 끝을 맞이하기 위해 살아남는다!
description.pl: Ed Rothstaylor to trzeciorzędny złoczyńca w grze, wyrzucony przez swoją rodzinę i wyrzucony z akademika za swoje złe uczynki. Pewnego dnia nasz główny bohater budzi się jako właśnie ten Ed i zdaje sobie sprawę, że musi zdobyć stypendium, aby ukończyć szkołę i zapewnić sobie przyszłość. Teraz mieszkając w lesie, postanawia trzymać się z dala od protagonistów, ale cztery z głównych bohaterek nie dają mu spokoju. Co więcej, jego obecność zaczyna zmieniać fabułę i wydarzenia w grze! Czy Ed pomoże w rozwoju historii, pozostając w cieniu?
description.ru:
Эд Лостейлор — третьесортный злодей в игре, отвергнутый семьей и изгнанный из общежития за свои проступки. Судьба делает неожиданный поворот, когда наш герой пробуждается в теле этого самого Эда и осознаёт: единственный путь к благополучному будущему — получить стипендию и окончить обучение.

Обосновавшись в лесной глуши, он твёрдо решает держаться подальше от главных героев игры. Однако четыре прекрасные героини словно заворожены им и никак не желают оставить его в покое. Более того, само его существование начинает искажать временную линию, меняя предначертанный ход событий!

Удастся ли Эду сохранить баланс между невмешательством и необходимостью двигать сюжет вперёд, оставаясь при этом в тени? Ведь каждое его действие может изменить судьбу целого мира...
description.zh:
从恶棍到生存王
打破命运的束缚！
意外穿成游戏中的三流反派，只想安稳低调地活下去。但这个世界却生存艰难！无法像主角那样光芒万丈，只能用三流反派的方式，在故事的尽头努力活下来！
description.pt-br: Eu possuía um personagem vilão extra de terceira categoria em meu jogo favorito. Não tenho ambições e só quero viver uma vida tranquila. Mas, caramba, este mundo é um lugar difícil de sobreviver. Eu sobreviverei até o final desta história, de uma forma que o protagonista não conseguirá. Sobreviverei à maneira de um personagem vilão de terceira categoria.
description.zh-hk: 轉生到自己最喜歡的遊戲後，我成為了不起眼的三流反派角色。雖然只想安安靜靜地生活，但是在這個世界很難生存下去。我沒什麼野心，目標就只有從學院畢業。 為了迎接這個故事的結局，我會用主角做不到的三流反派方式活下來！

description.en:
My name is Amy. Reincarnating as the little sister of a character from a book I read in my previous life was great, but… On my 16th birthday, my older sister said she had something special prepared and picked up a guy in the forest?!?

"Picking up" a "guy" was surprising enough, but that guy was actually the Mad Archduke (…and male lead) who was a child by day and adult by night because of a curse-like spell! He was "Lennox Iberich."

"Who are you."

"I-I was the one who picked you up and brought you here!"

To prevent the original plot line of my sister dying after picking up the male lead, I had no choice but to raise the death flag instead. But…

"Amy. I can only see you at night. There's no meaning to a night without you."

…Huh? This… wasn't it a "death" flag, not a "love" flag…?

description.ko:
내 이름은 에이미.

전생에 읽은 책 속 조연의 동생으로 다시 태어난 것까진 좋은데…
16살이 되는 생일날 아침, 언니가 특별한 걸 준비했다며
숲속에서 남자 하나를 주워 왔다?!!

‘남자’를 ‘주워’ 왔다는 것만으로도 경악할 일인데
그보다 더 충격적인 사실은,
이 남자가 낮에는 어린아이였다가 밤에는 성인이 되는
저주 같은 마법에 걸린 미친 대공(…이자 남자 주인공!)
‘리녹 이베르크’라는 것.

“넌 누구냐.”
“다, 당신을 주워온 것은 나예요!”

원작의 내용처럼 남자 주인공을 주워 와서
죽음을 맞이하게 되는 언니를 살리기 위해
어쩔 수 없이 내가 사망 플래그를 꽂은 줄 알았는데….

“에이미. 내가 널 볼 수 있는 시간은 밤뿐인데,
네가 없는 밤은… 아무런 의미가 없다.”

……어라?

이거, 사‘망’ 플래그가 아니라
사‘랑’ 플래그였나……?

밤만 되면 치명적인 매력을 발산하는 이 늑대 같은 남자로부터
나는 정말 멀리 벗어날 수 있을까??

Jin Runcandel was destined to become the head of his swordmaster clan. But despite his best efforts, he's banished for his shoddy swordsmanship. Armed with a second chance and some new powers, Jin swears to fulfill his destiny and become the ultimate swordmaster!

description.de: Dohee, die ihr Leben lang von ihrem Umfeld ausgenutzt wurde, erwacht nach einem tödlichen Motorradunfall im Körper von Debora Shimore, der Antagonistin einer beliebten Reverse-Harem-Webnovel. Sie beschließt, sich nicht länger ausnutzen zu lassen und ihr neues Leben als Schurkin zu genießen. Sie muss nur sicherstellen, dass Debora nicht ihr vorbestimmtes Ende als Gefangene im Kloster findet. Dafür braucht sie, so glaubt sie anfangs, nur der Protagonistin und ihrem Harem aus dem Weg zu gehen, doch schon bald wird sie gezwungen, aktiver zu werden und sich mit dem Goldenen Drachen einzulassen.
description.en:
She possessed a villainess who is known and hated for her evil acts in an unpopular novel. But because of her personality, it was extremely difficult for her to play the villainess role. But not for long…

“I’ll fix your dress according to your taste this instant!”

“My request.”

“O-Of course! As per your request, there’s only one piece available in the whole Empire.”

People around me listen to me well even if I just frown and sit still. Since I don’t have to live in difficulty, I decided to just comfortably live on as a villainess.

“Father. Is it necessary for you to solve formulas in this slow and inefficient way?”

I thought it would be good to be a rich villainess, so I used all my knowledge.

“Why don’t you give me the honor of escorting the Princess?”

I have had enough of dealing with my father, so why did an unexpected character suddenly appear? What if this person disrupts my plan?

---
Dohee lived as a pushover, died miserably, and was reborn in a novel as a notorious villainess. But it turns out that her new life is not without its perks, as Deborah Seymour is also the richest villain alive. Now, all that's left for her to do is lay low and enjoy her carefree lifestyle...if not for the fact that Deborah is fated to be sent to a monastery! Will this ex-doormat find a way to avoid yet another tragic ending, or will the challenges of being a villainess be too much for her?
description.fr:
Dohee a vécu comme une poule mouillée, a péri misérablement et a été réincarnée dans un roman en tant que vilaine notoire. Mais il s'avère que sa nouvelle vie n'est pas sans avantages, car Deborah Seymour est aussi la méchante la plus riche de l'Empire. Il ne lui reste plus qu'à faire profil bas et à profiter de son insouciance... Si ce n'est que Deborah est condamnée à être envoyée dans un monastère! Cette ancienne fainéante trouvera-t-elle un moyen d'éviter une nouvelle fin tragique, ou les défis d'une méchante seront-ils trop importants pour elle?

---
Debora Seymour est la pire vilaine jamais écrite: elle ne cesse de persécuter Mya, l’héroïne du roman, depuis qu’elle a appris que Pilaf Montes, l’homme dont elle est éprise, n’a d’yeux que pour elle. Mais quand Dohee, une étudiante en architecture, meurt et se réincarne dans sa peau, elle est bien contente d’être devenu quelqu’un qui ne se laisse pas marcher dessus. Elle va enfin pouvoir passer sa vie à se la couler douce!  Mais c’est sans compter une loi qui impose aux jeunes filles de famille noble à se marier à l’âge adulte. L’alternative est simple : acquérir un titre de noblesse. Mais par quel moyen? En l’achetant. Dohee va alors mettre au point un plan pour devenir riche.
description.hr:
Yoon Dohee, studentica arhitektonskog fakulteta, otkriva da ju njezine kolege i obitelj iskorištavaju za novac i kao besplatnu radnu snagu točno prije nego pogine u prometnoj nesreći.
Umjesto da zapravo umre ona se reinkarnira u ljubavni roman koji je nedavno čitala, ali ne kao glavni lik, nego kao glavni zlikovac i antagonist knjige Deborah Seymour.
Sada kao Deborah ona navigira novi život odmarajući se u bogatstu i raskoši, ali mora biti na oprezu jer je njezina reputacija duboko pod zemljom, a lik Debore u originalnoj knjizi završava svoju priču u tamnici.
description.id: Kehidupan Yoon Dohee, wanita naif yang kerap dimanfaatkan oleh orang sekitarnya berubah drastis. Setelah dia mengalami kecelakaan dan sekarat, dia merasuk ke dalam tubuh wanita jahat bernama Deborah Seymour. Deborah Seymour adalah seorang tokoh di novel reverse harem rating 19+ berjudul 'A Dark Thorn Through My Throat'. Karena tidak ingin ada orang lain yang tahu kalau sebenarnya Yoon Dohee adalah wanita naif, dia akhirnya belajar untuk menjadi jahat seperti Deborah Seymour. "Aku tidak akan hidup sebagai orang yang baik dan menyedihkan seperti di masa lalu. Aku akan terus hidup enak sebagai wanita jahat!"

description.pl: Dohee żyła jako popychadło, zmarła marnie i odrodziła się w powieści jako Nikczemność. Okazuje się jednak, że jej nowe życie nie jest pozbawione zalet, ponieważ Debora Seymour jest również najbogatszym żyjącym złoczyńcą. Teraz pozostaje jej tylko przyczaić się i cieszyć się beztroskim stylem życia... Gdyby nie fakt, że Debora jest skazana na wysłanie do klasztoru! Czy ta była ladacznica znajdzie sposób, by uniknąć kolejnego tragicznego zakończenia, czy też wyzwania związane z byciem łotrem to dla niej zbyt wiele?
description.ru:
Я переродилась в трагично-жестоком романе в ужасную злодейку, которую ненавидят, что бы она ни делала. Но разочарование было недолгим.

"Сейчас же сделайте платье по вкусу герцогини!"
"Чего-то вроде домашнего задания, разумеется, нет".
"Это единственный драгоценный камень в империи, который ты хотела".

Даже если я просто смирно сижу с недовольным выражением лица, окружающие люди ходят по струнке.
Разве есть необходимость быть тряпкой? Будет удобнее просто дальше жить как злодейка.

"Отец, обязательно ли решать пример таким медленным и неэффективным способом?"

Раз уж так вышло, я решила стать богатой злодейкой, поэтому воспользовалась всеми имеющимися знаниями.

"Как насчет того, чтобы оказать мне честь и позволить быть вашим эскортом?"

Мало было отца, мне еще неожиданно повезло с темной лошадкой, которой не было в планах.
description.uk:
Ду Хі опанувала тіло лиходійки одного непопулярного роману, яка була відома і ненависна всім за свої погані вчинки. Але через власний характер їй дуже важко правильно грати роль злодійки. Але ненадовго.. 

"Я зміню сукню згідно з вашим смаком негайно" 

"Моє прохання." 

"З-звісно! Згідно з вашим запитом, у всій імперії є лише одна річ." 

Люди навколо мене добре слухають, навіть якщо я просто хмурюсь і сиджу на місці. Оскільки мені не доводиться жити в труднощах, я вирішила просто комфортно жити у тілі лиходійки. 

«Батько, чи потрібно вам розв’язувати формули таким повільним і неефективним способом?» 

Я подумала, що було б добре бути багатою негідницею, тому використовувала усі свої знання. 

«Чому б вам не надати мені честь супроводжувати принцесу?» 

У мене досить багато справ з батьком, так чому раптом з’явився цей неочікуваний персонаж? Що, якщо ця людина спробує порушити мій план?

description.en:
Angela was my friend. I wanted to give anything to her, who I thought more precious than my own family. And I eventually turned Angela, a lowly aristocrat from the countryside, into the flower of the capital society. But it was betrayal that came back. She sold me and my family to become an imperial princess.

"…Did you have to go this far?"
"Because I wanted you to be unhappy. I wanted to take your whole life away."

But when I thought I had died under the guillotine, I was surprisingly back in the past.

"Oh, hello. My name is Angela Vito…"
"You're Angela! Nice to meet you. Everyone was waiting for you."

With a bright smile, I held her hands together again.

---
My best friend betrayed me! Born from a low-ranking noble family, Angela grew to be renowned for her beauty and grace, becoming the prized angel of society, all with my enthusiastic support. Yet beneath that glitz and polish, she was simply... evil. She used me and had me killed out of sheer spite in her quest to become the empire’s greatest woman. But unlucky for her, a magical gift from a dragon has given me a second chance at life. No longer blinded by her light, I’ll do all I can to stop her!
description.fr:
Angela était mon amie. J'aurai pu faire n'importe quoi pour celle que je considérais comme plus précieuse que ma propre famille. Et j'ai fini par transformer Angela, une humble aristocrate de la campagne, en la fleur de la société. En remerciement je n'ai reçu que mensonge et trahison. Elle nous a vendu, ma famille et moi, pour devenir une princesse impériale.

"…Fallait-il que tu ailles aussi loin?"
"Je voulais que tu sois malheureuse. Je voulais te prendre toute ta vie."

Et lorsque j'ai cru mourir guillotiné, je suis revenue dans le passé.

"Oh, bonjour. Je m'appelle Angela Vito…"
"Vous êtes Angela ! Ravie de vous rencontrer. Tout le monde vous attendait."

Avec un sourire éclatant, je lui ai de nouveau tenu les mains.

---
Angela est ma chère amie à qui j’ai donné tout mon cœur, et elle m'a remerciée... en me trahisant. Pour devenir princesse héritière, elle a détruit ma famille et m’a envoyée à la guillotine. Mais au moment de l'exécution, je suis remontée dans le temps comme par miracle pour me retrouver au jour de ma première rencontre avec elle. Cette fois-ci, je ne me laisserai pas faire: ce sera maintenant à mon tour la faire souffrir.

description.en:
King, magician, musician, prosecutor, wealthy person, beggar, saintess, witch… She lived for a thousand years, many times over. Sometimes she was the noblest person in the world, sometimes she was the humblest. Among them, her 53rd life was one of the most wretched and painful of them all.

Once she reached her 54th life, she was worn out.

"Everything is so troublesome. I'd like to have some rest now."

This time, even though she had already made up her mind to live a life of a lazy sloth, no matter what it takes…

"Why do you keep bothering me… Sis, let's get some rest."

Her story of wanting to rest!  

---
It is my cursed destiny to be reborn endlessly. A king, an archmage, a slave, a saint, a witch... I've done it all in my thousand years of life, and frankly, I need a break! My goal now is simple: to live like an absolute sloth. Unfortunately, I am Rubia, the daughter of a grand duke with a demanding family and a fiancé to boot. To live my dream sloth life, I'm running away from it all... except no matter where I go, nobody will leave me be! I just want to nap, but being lazy is hard work!
description.ru: 53? 54? - это число жизней, которые я пережила за последние 1000 лет. Я была и волшебницей, и музыкантом, и актрисой, и доктором, и много кем еще. Я устала от всего этого! В новой жизни, которая вот-вот начнется… я собираюсь жить как ленивец! Но вот беда, я стала принцессой! Но это не повод расстраиваться! Я собираюсь отдохнуть в этой жизни!

description.en:
The handsome Duke Voreoti is the most terrifying man in the empire, with the coldest of demeanors and a gaze that can kill. But one day, he suddenly says that he wants to… adopt a child?! And that child is me?! After finding me at a shady orphanage, he whisked me away to his snowy palace without a second thought. Now I’m learning all the ways of the feared Voreoti family from his knights. However, things get dicey when the Duke becomes suspicious of my origins. With these fangs and jet black hair, perhaps we are more than just kindred spirits…

---
"I'm going to adopt a child."

Duke Phileo Boleoti's impulsive decision shocked everyone in the mansion. Not only did he make her his daughter, but he also gave her the name of a 'beast' that only direct members of the bloodline could receive.

"Even as you breathe right now, I'm earning money."
"It's confidence, not arrogance."
"My face really does have its advantages."
The most arrogant father in the whole world, and-

"I love muscles the most. Let's get muscular."
"Show me your thigh muscles! Your butt would be even better!"
"You're nothing but a flower if you have a calm personality…" his corrupted(?) daughter. 

And… "I will give his excellency the information he wants most."

"Information I want most, you say…"

"You won’t regret it."

…A stepmother(?) with a strange secret as well.
description.fr: Le duc Voreoti est riche, puissant, séduisant et craint. Techniquement, il a tout ce qu'il faut pour être heureux, et il s'en satisfait. Mais le jour où son meilleur ami lui parle du bonheur d'être père, il cède à l'appel du cœur. C'est décidé, il adoptera un orphelin et en fera son héritier! Mais il faudra pour ça que cet enfant soit à la hauteur de ses attentes… et il se pourrait bien qu'en adoptant Léonie sur un coup de tête, le fauve se soit trouvé une sacrée lionne!
description.id:
Keputusan mendadak Duke Ferio Voleoti membuat semua orang terkejut. Tidak hanya itu, ia juga memberikan nama yang hanya bisa didapatkan oleh keturunan keluarga Voleoti. Terlebih, anak yang ia adopsi itu juga memiliki penampilan yang begitu mirip dengan Duke sendiri. "Bahkan saat bernapas saja, kita menghasilkan uang." "Itu namanya percaya diri, bukan arogan." "Aku suka dengan otot yang kuat dan besar!" "Ayah macam apa kamu?" Cerita tentang ayah yang arogan serta anak yang unik pun dimulai.

----
Duke Voreoti yang tampan adalah pria paling menakutkan di kekaisaran. Tapi suatu hari, dia ingin mengadopsi seorang anak?!

description.de:
Das bekannteste VR-Spiel der Welt, 'Kaillan'. Ian ist ein zertifizierter Spielsüchtiger, der in der virtuellen Welt bekannt ist. Obwohl Ian einen Level 93 Archer-Charakter in den Top-Bestenlisten von Kaillan hat, beschließt er, ihn zu löschen, obwohl alle um ihn herum ihm gesagt haben, er solle es nicht tun. Alles, um sich in eine versteckte Klasse zu verwandeln, die er zufällig erhalten hatte. Die Klasse, die er gewählt hat, ist die wertloseste Klasse in Kaillan, die Summoner-Klasse. Wenn er vermeiden will, ein F im College zu bekommen, muss er innerhalb von zwei Monaten auf sein vorheriges Level aufsteigen … Kaillan ist bekannt für sein sehr grausames Levelsystem, bei dem es über ein Jahr dauern soll, bis Level 100 erreicht ist. Seine Kämpfe, in nur zwei Monaten Level 93 zu erreichen, entfalten sich … Level schnell, gründlich und beharrlich. Die Legende vom 'Bändigungsmeister' beginnt! - Google Translate, bessere Übersetzung kommt bald…

description.en: Jinsung may look like your average college student, but in the harsh VR world of Kaillan, he’s Ian, a mighty level 93 archer! So when he suddenly resets his character, everyone thinks he’s totally nuts! What they don’t realize is that Jinsung has unlocked a powerful, new hidden class. Now, taming monsters is tough, and leveling up is a slog. But when his VR-loving teacher threatens to fail him, Jinsung has just two months to level up and achieve glory as the one and only Taming Master!
description.es: En el juego de realidad virtual más jugado del mundo "Kaillan", un certificado adicto al juego bien conocido como, Ian. A pesar de tener un personaje arquero de nivel 93 en la cima de la tabla de puntuaciones de Kaillan, Ian decide borrarlo aun cuando todos le decían que no lo hiciera. Solo para obtener una oportunidad de desbloquear una clase oculta. La clase de personaje que escogió es la más inútil en Kaillan, la clase invocadora, si quiere evitar el sacar una calificación de F en la universidad, el necesita que su personaje llegue al nivel que tenía su antiguo personaje en un lapso de 2 meses... Kaillan es notorio por su cruel sistema de niveles, donde se dice que puede tomar un año alcanzar el nivel 100. Su lucha por llegar al nivel 93 en solo 2 meses comienza... Subiendo rápidamente de niveles, a través de la perseverancia. La leyenda de el "Maestro Domador" ¡comienza!
description.id:
Ian, atau yang bernama asli Park Jinseong ialah seorang mahasiswa jurusan Virtual Reality ini merupakan salah satu dari jutaan user VR game terkenal di dunia 'Kaillan'. Tak sengaja melihat berita tentang pekerjaan tersembunyi baru, Ian yang saat itu seorang Archer jutawan merasa tertarik untuk mengganti pekerjaannya dan menjelajah dunia baru. Meski dengan resiko kehilangan semua kemampuan juga harta, ditambah dengan taruhan dengan sang dosen yang mengancam akan memberi surat peringatan dan nilai F di semua kelas jika tak bisa kembali ke level 93, Ian tetap memilih untuk mengganti pekerjaan sebagai Animal Summoner yang menurut kebanyakan orang payah. Ia menemukan keseruan tersendiri merawat dan berpetualang bersama temannya 'Rai' menangkap banyak monster.

Lalu, bagaimana serunya petualangan Ian dan 'Rai' di Kaillan hingga menjadi Taming Master? Apakah Ian bisa memenangkan taruhan dengan sang dosen dan terbebas dari nilai F serta surat peringatan universitas?

전 세계에서 가장 인지도 높은 VR(가상현실) 게임 ‘카일란’. 
가상현실학과에서도 유명한 자타공인의 게임 폐인 이안. 

서버에서 순위권에 드는 궁수로서 남부러울 것 없는 그가
우연히 획득하게 된 히든 클래스로의 전직을 위해 주위의 반대를 무릅쓰고
93레벨의 캐릭터를 과감히 삭제한다.

그가 선택한 것은 카일란 최고의 노답 직업인 소환술사? 
엎친 데 덮친 격으로 F학점을 피하려면 두 달 안에 
삭제한 캐릭터의 레벨까지 올려야 하는데…

100렙까지는 1년이 걸린다는 극악의 레벨업을 자랑하는 카일란에서
불과 두 달만에 93레벨을 찍기 위한 그의 고군분투가 펼쳐지는데...

레벨 업을 향해 더 빨리, 더 철저하게, 더 끈질기게
『테이밍 마스터』의 전설이 시작된다!

description.en:
A heart-throbbing, royal fantasy comic on the romance of Moo-young, a fierce beast who disguises as a puppy to gain love; and Hwa-yeon, a girl, who raises and trains a large puppy, oblivious to its real identity.

WARNING: Foolish girls and boys are conveniently stationed at every twist and turn. Enjoy~
description.fr: Réveillée après un long sommeil de plusieurs années, son papa-poule surprotecteur ne la lâche plus d’une semelle... Pour couronner le tout, il se trouve être le premier ministre de l'empire! Mais alors qu’elle va lui rendre visite au palais où il travaille, elle se perd dans un grand bâtiment où se repose un étrange personnage. Gigantesque, hirsute, affamé… Serait-il le fameux prince héritier que tout le monde craint?!
description.it: La storia d'amore tra Moo-young, una bestia feroce che si traveste da cucciolo per guadagnarsi l'affetto, e Hwa-yeon, una ragazza che alleva e addestra un grande cucciolo, ignara della sua vera identità...

description.th: 'ลียอนอู' มีชีวิตอยู่อย่างเดียวดายในโลกปัจจุบัน พอจะมีความสุขก็ต้องมาเสียสามี และโดนทำร้ายร่างกายอย่างรุนแรง เธอย้อนอดีตไปฟื้นในร่างของ 'รยูฮวายอน' หญิงสาวผู้อ่อนหวาน ลูกสาวสุดที่รักของอัครมหาเสนาบดีแห่งอาณาจักรฮวันที่หลับใหลจากอาการป่วยมานานถึง 12 ปี ที่นี่เธอมีชีวิตที่มีความสุข มีครอบครัวที่รักต่างจากโลกที่เคยจากมา จนกระทั่งวันหนึ่งเธอเข้าไปหาพ่อในวัง และได้พบกับองค์รัชทายาทผู้เสเพลโดยบังเอิญ
description.uk:
«Можливо, це лише сон Хва Йон? Або ж Йон У створила цей світ у своїй голові, щоб втекти від суворої реальності?»

Рю Хва Йон раптово впадає в кому у віці шести років. Після довгих 12 років, протягом яких її батько, Рю Чон, наполегливо шукає спосіб її врятувати, вона нарешті розплющує очі. Прокинувшись від тривалого сну, вона усвідомлює, що має не лише свої спогади, а й спогади Лі Йон У. Подолавши свій страх, їй вдається пристосуватися до нового життя. Одного дня, сподіваючись пообідати зі своїм батьком, вона вирушає до палацу, де випадково опиняється перед сумнозвісним звіром…
description.pt-br: Uma emocionante história de fantasia sobre o romance de Moo-young, um animal feroz que se disfarça de filhotinho para conquistar um amor; e Hwa-yeon, uma garota que cria e treina um grande filhote de cachorro, sem saber a sua verdadeira identidade.

description.en:
As Ersella lies on her deathbed, she has only one regret: never being a good mother to her son, Vicente. When fate sends her back three years, she gets a chance to make things right. While reflecting on her past as a young bride and reluctant mother, Ersella begins to untangle years’ worth of heartache. But as familial, marital, and even political issues enter the picture, she realizes there’s more to her second life than she thought. Will Ersella’s change of heart be too little, too late? 

---
Ercella lived a glorious life everyone envied, but died of an illness at a young age. Before her death, she regretted not having become a proper mother to her son. But somehow, she went back three years ago. Ercella is living her second life. She promises to be a loving mother this time. However, is it too late?

“Now that you’re doing this, you’re just making me feel uncomfortable.”

The son only pushes her away and she realises that her relationship with the husband, who she thought was fine before her regression, wasn't actually…

---
**Content warning:** Deals with topics of child neglect, postpartum depression, and suicidal ideation.

description.ru:
Эрселла, жившая яркой жизнью, которой все завидовали, умерла от болезни в молодом возрасте.

Она жалела, что не была настоящей матерью своему сыну перед смертью.

Но чудесным образом девушка вернулась на три года назад. Теперь Эрселла живет своей второй жизнью.

"Обещаю быть доброй матерью на этот раз."

Но не слишком ли поздно?

-Теперь, когда ты делаешь это, я чувствую себя неловко. - Сын оттолкнул ее.

И Эрселла поняла, что ее отношения с мужем, который, по ее мнению, был в порядке до ее возвращения, были неправильными.

description.en:
To Neveah, the world seemed like an eternal winter. Her parents and maids had given her the cold shoulder ever since she was a baby. When she fell down in the snow, no one spared her a glance. It was truly a dreadful winter.

While living day to day like a doll on a display shelf, Neveah was engaged as part of a pre-natal agreement between her father and her fiancé’s father. Her fiancé was a Wistash. Duke Valor Wistash.

As in the prelude to every tragedy, it all began with a damned love.

"Love has its moments. You missed them all, and now I don't love you anymore," Neveah said to her fiancé who had never once looked at her for the past decade, then left the Empire for the neighboring country where she was welcomed with open arms.

She didn't expect anything there and was simply planning to live quietly, but the Emperor's attitude towards her was exceedingly friendly.

"I want you to be happy. You can wish for anything and do as you please. I want to give you a season where you don't have to be constantly wary of other people."

After meeting Arendt, Neveah's winter began to overflow… into spring as the snow began to melt.

---
Ever since she was little, Neveah has felt lonely. Since birth, she has been engaged to a man she is in love with. Unfortunately, her fiancé ignored her for ten years.

Finally, she decides to break her engagement and change her life. Her solution? Asking the Emperor's hand in marriage! For this, she will have to respect several conditions, the first one: never falling in love with him.

Aideen, the esteemed daughter of a duke and the Emperor’s direct assassin, the leader of ‘Owl.’  
I gave everything to my Lord but I only received betrayal and deception in return, and death.  
  
“I will take revenge on you. I will never forgive you even in my death!”

I decided to destroy Perdi, a country that the Emperor cherished more than his life..  
  
"You are beautiful, Milady. Especially those red eyes of yours."  
  
The man who personally sent the order to send Aideen to the guillotine, the Prince from the enemy country, Diceon, unexpectedly began to interfere with her life!  
  
Aideen, the woman abandoned by the Emperor had come back to life, her second life to get revenge and destroy her home country now unfolds!

description.de: Clarence hatte ihr Zuhause als normale Bürgerliche verlassen und war als Kriegsheldin zurückgekehrt. Sie würde aber lieber ohne die Bürde dieser Ehre leben. Gequält von ihren schrecklichen Erinnerungen an das Schlachtfeld, kehrt sie ihrer Ritterschaft den Rücken und verlässt die Stadt. Aber trotz ihrer Hoffnungen, in Ruhe und Frieden in ihre Heimat zurückkehren zu können, verursacht Clarences Verschwinden einen regelrechten Aufruhr in der Hauptstadt. Jetzt sind ihr ein königlicher Prinz, ein höhnischer Magier, ein weiser Priester und ein treuer Ritter auf den Fersen. Es stellt sich heraus, dass ihre Kameraden wesentlich positivere Erinnerungen an ihre gemeinsame Zeit haben, als sie jemals dachte. Als die Suchaktion voranschreitet und Clarence damit kämpft, die Vergangenheit hinter sich zu lassen, findet sie nach und nach heraus,
description.en:
Clarence left home a peasant and returned a war hero, but she could do without the burden of all that glory. Tormented by the bitter memories of her time on the battlefield, she abandons her knighthood and sets off from the city. 

But despite her hopes for a quiet return home, Clarence's disappearance causes quite a stir in the capital. Now she has the likes of an imperial prince, a snarky magician, a wise priest, and a loyal knight all hot on her trail. 

It turns out that her comrades in war possessed much fonder memories of her than she had ever imagined. As the search goes on and Clarence struggles to put the past behind her, this dame may just come to find that some memories weren't meant to be forgotten.
description.fr: Lorsque Clarence avait quitté sa ville natale pour se rendre à la capitale, elle n’était encore qu’une simple paysanne. Mais après avoir accepté de combattre parmi les chevaliers, le destin a fait d’elle une véritable héroïne de guerre. Ceci dit, Clarence se passerait bien du poids des honneurs. Tourmentée par les souvenirs amers du temps passé sur les champs de bataille, elle finit par abandonner son poste et quitter la ville. Mais alors qu’elle espère rentrer calmement auprès de sa famille, sa disparition soudaine cause un véritable tumulte. Elle se retrouve maintenant avec un prince impérial, un grand magicien, un sage prêtre et un chevalier loyal à ses trousses! Il semblerait en effet que ses camarades de guerre aient gardé de bien plus précieux souvenirs d’elle qu’elle n’aurait pu l’imaginer et ne soient pas prêts à la laisser disparaître si facilement. Alors qu’une véritable quête s’organise pour retrouver Clarence, cette dernière, qui espérait faire table rase du passé, pourrait bien réaliser que certains souvenirs ne sont pas faits pour être oubliés.
description.ko:
“떠나겠습니다.”
“이렇게 갑자기 고향으로 돌아가면, 전우들이 아쉬워 할 텐데?”
“기반 하나 없는 평민 기사를 기억할 이는 아무도 없을 겁니다.”

전쟁이 끝나고, 평민 출신의 기사 ‘클라렌스 홀턴’은
전쟁의 승리 후 자신이 받을 수 있는 약속된 명예와 행복을 마다한 채
모든 걸 내려놓고 홀연히 떠나게 된다.

하지만.

“대체, 클라렌스는 어디로 갔단 말입니까!”

아무도 자신을 기억하지 못할 거라는 그녀의 예상과는 달리,
그녀가 떠났다는 소식에 제국의 황태자도, 과묵한 기사 단장도,
천재 마법사도, 신전의 사제까지 일어섰다.

그리고 사라진 그녀를 향한 추격전!
클라렌스에게 찾아올 네 명의 행복을 기다리는 힐링 로맨스 판타지!
description.ru:
— Я ухожу.
— Ты уверена? Те, кто сражался вместе с тобой на войне, будут опечалены такой вестью.
— Я думаю, они даже не вспомнят меня...

Когда война закончилась и Королевство получило желанную победу, Кларенс Холтон, рыцарь из простого народа, отказалась принять награду и честь, обещанную ей. Она не принимает все это и скорее решает уйти.

— Почему ты не хочешь сказать нам, куда, черт возьми, делась Кларенс?

Но вопреки ее убеждению, никто не забыл о ней. Наоборот, были ошарашены, как только услышали эту новость. Наследный принц, их безмолвный вожак из рыцарей, гениальный волшебник и жрец храма последуют за ней, с целью найти пропавшую девушку.

description.en:
"Please have a happy marriage with me for just six months."  
"What good does that have for me?  
“Of course we’ll give you the Reno family's estates and fortune.”  
“…Let’s say you give it all to me. You said you’ll divorce me in half a year. If that’s so, what will you do afterwards?”  
“…There’s something I’ve been thinking about doing. I won’t be able to use the money anyway.”  
  
Clea always lied. This body will soon die. It’ll barely last half a year.  
  
After being in a satisfying marriage, Clea Reno wanted to close her eyes for the final time in a quiet place.  
  
#  
  
When I was stabbed to death, I was summoned before the Demon King and was given a six-month time limit as a villainess.  
  
“Keuk-“  
  
My body uses up one energy when taking a step, three health when talking, 300 of my health after running for ten seconds, and I throw up blood when a third of my energy is spent.  
  
“Oh my, she’s doing that again for attention.”  
“It’s surprising that she carries paint wherever she goes.”  
“Well, His Excellency Detroit did reject her coldly.”  
  
My reputation was the worst.  
  
The Demon Lord said he’ll save my body if I get married happily, but the condition is mortifying.  
  
I have to get married to the man I’ve had an unrequited crush on, Duke Detroit.   
  
I said I’ll do anything in order to get married, but I don’t know what a “happy marriage” is…  
  
Will I be able to survive?  

---
